prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1328; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a parking lot collision between two vehicles at low speed. Claimant reports being struck while backing out of a space. Claimant states a wrist injury occurred when they braced against the steering wheel. Claimant is not represented by counsel. Recorded statement scheduled.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from claimant. Claimant describes the impact as moderate and confirms seeking urgent care the same day. Claimant reports pain and swelling in the right wrist and is awaiting imaging results. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file.

Entry 3: Imaging report received from claimant's treating provider. Diagnosis is a fracture of the distal radius of the right wrist, treated with a splint and referral to an orthopedic specialist. Claimant was advised of their right to seek legal advice, and stated they are handling the matter directly for now. Medical authorization form sent to claimant for signature.

Entry 4: Signed medical authorization returned. Records requested from urgent care and orthopedic clinic. Claimant reports missing several days of work and has been asked to provide employer wage verification. Property damage estimate completed on claimant's vehicle and adjusted for prior minor damage noted in photos.

Entry 5: Liability review in progress. Other driver's statement indicates they did not see the claimant's vehicle until contact. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from property owner. File flagged for supervisor review due to injury component. Claimant to be contacted for status update once records are received.
